newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: San Miguel 9-mth net 3.74 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: San Miguel 9-mth net 3.74 bln pesos.

text.p: Beer and food firm San Miguel Corporation on Thursday reported that net profit in the first nine months of the year rose to 3.74 billion pesos from 4.20 billion in the year-ago period.
Both the figures include extraordinary gains, a San Miguel statement said.
Stripped of the extraordinary gains, San Miguel's 1996 nine month net was at 2.99 billion pesos versus 3.9 billion in the year-ago period, the company said.
San Miguel said the non-recurring income in the nine-month 1996 period came from a writeback to profit of 561 million pesos.

The writeback came from provisions set aside in previous years for income taxes on possible future dividend income from San Miguel's foreign subsidiaries and gains on sale of certain properties and investment.
The company did not specify the sources of extraordinary income in the 1995 period.
The recurring net income for the third quarter was 1.05 billion pesos, down from 1.16 billion pesos in the year-ago quarter.
Sales revenue for the third quarter was 19.3 billion pesos, up from 18.4 billion pesos in the year-ago period.
For the nine-month 1996 period, the consolidated revenue was 61.2 billion pesos, up from 56.1 billion pesos.

San Miguel said the improvement in the third quarter was due to higher sales volume which grew collectively by six percent in the third quarter compared to only two percent in the first half, lower raw material costs and improved margins in the food segment.
